Job Title: Product Manager - HR Applications

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: None

Type of Travel: None

* * *

CACI is seeking a Product Manager to support, plan, deliver, and lifecycle management of human resources applications and related enterprise capabilities. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, functional users, and technical delivery teams to ensure HR application investments align with mission needs, workforce requirements, and enterprise modernization goals.
The ideal candidate brings experience in Agile product management within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment and has working familiarity with PeopleSoft and NGA enterprise systems. This individual will help define priorities, manage product backlogs, coordinate releases, and drive continuous improvement across HR application capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:
•              Serve as Product Manager for HR applications within Customers Corporate Applications portfolio.
•              Define product vision, roadmap, and priorities in alignment with organizational objectives and user needs.
•              Partner with HR stakeholders, business process owners, developers, architects, testers, and program leadership to translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
•              Maintain and prioritize product backlogs, features, and enablers in a SAFe Agile environment.
•              Support Program Increment (PI) planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and other Agile ceremonies as appropriate.
•              Develop and communicate product goals, release plans, dependency risks, and delivery status to stakeholders.
•              Ensure HR application capabilities support business processes such as personnel actions, talent management, workforce administration, reporting, and related enterprise functions.
•              Coordinate enhancements, defect resolution, system integrations, and sustainment activities for PeopleSoft-based and related corporate applications.
•              Gather, analyze, and validate user requirements, ensuring alignment with technical feasibility and mission value.
•              Use metrics, stakeholder feedback, and operational insight to inform prioritization and continuous product improvement.
•              Support change management, user adoption, and stakeholder engagement efforts associated with new or updated HR capabilities.
•              Collaborate with cybersecurity, data, testing, and infrastructure teams to support compliant and reliable delivery of enterprise solutions.
•              Identify risks, issues, and dependencies affecting product delivery and recommend mitigation strategies.

Required Qualifications
•              Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field.
•              At least 5 years of experience serving in a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar product delivery role supporting enterprise applications.
•              Experience working in a SAFe environment, including backlog management, PI planning, and cross-team coordination.
•              Familiarity with PeopleSoft applications, particularly HR or human capital management modules.
•              Knowledge of enterprise HR business processes and supporting application workflows.
•              Experience translating stakeholder needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product priorities.
•              Ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
•              Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
•              Experience supporting complex system integrations and enterprise application environments.
•              Ability to analyze competing priorities and make recommendations based on mission and business value.
•              Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

Desired Qualifications
•              Experience supporting Intelligence Community or Department of War enterprise environments.
•              Familiarity with Intel systems, processes, and governance structures.
•              Experience with HR modernization, digital transformation, or enterprise platform sustainment effort

Job Title: Product Manager

Job Category: Project and Program Management

Time Type: Full time

Employee Type: Regular

* * *

The Opportunity:
The Product Manager leads customer focused, results driven platform and production support services for cloud hosted, microservices based applications. This role focuses on strengthening user relationships, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring consistent, high quality delivery of production support outcomes. Operating at the intersection of technology, business processes, and mission needs, the Product Manager ensures stability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement of Tier 3 support and platform operations.

As the Product Manager, you will work across technical, operational, and business teams to guide platform strategy, elevate user experience, streamline support processes, and drive measurable improvements in production health. You will analyze user trends, represent mission and customer needs, manage production issues from discovery through remediation, and ensure platform stability in a dynamic and highly visible environment. This role is ideal for a senior professional who blends analytical skill, operational insight, stakeholder communication, and leadership in cloud native environments.

Responsibilities:
•            Cross Team Communication & Alignment
o            Communicate effectively across technical and business teams to ensure timely, accurate, and mission aligned outcomes.
o            Serve as the primary liaison between engineering, Tier 3 support, system owners, leadership, and end users, ensuring shared understanding of priorities, impacts, and expectations.

•            Platform & Tier 3 Support Management
o            Develop, refine, and continuously improve platform support processes, Tier 3 workflows, escalation paths, and operational readiness checklists.
o            Partner with engineering teams to ensure production stability, timely incident response, and effective long term remediation strategies.

•            User Advocacy, Incident Analysis & Trend Reduction
o            Represent user needs and mission priorities, ensuring operational decisions reflect business impact.
o            Analyze incident and ticket trends to identify recurring issues, systemic defects, workflow inefficiencies, and opportunities for proactive reduction of repeat incidents.
o            Drive short term and long term improvements in user experience, production reliability, and operational throughput.

•            Production Issue Prioritization & Remediation Support
o            Prioritize production support requests across multiple teams and stakeholders based on severity, mission impact, and business priorities.
o            Enable effective root cause analysis (RCA), partner with engineering to validate fixes, and track remediation actions through completion.
o            Manage production data changes, ensuring accuracy, auditability, governance compliance, and risk mitigation.

•            Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
o            Drive consistent execution of support processes using KPIs, dashboards, and feedback loops.
o            Introduce and maintain disciplined change management practices aligned with the team’s Agile delivery cycles.
o            Promote operational stability while also identifying modernization opportunities within platform services and support architectures.

Qualifications:
•            U.S. citizenship with ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
•            Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of relevant experience.
•            Background in product management or business analysis, with strong familiarity in Agile environments, capability planning, and change management.
•            Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to analyze user data, articulate trends, and communicate insights to leadership and technical teams.
Desired:
•            Experience in Operations & Maintenance (O&M) environments, including Service Desk, Tier 3 support, and platform management.
•            Familiarity with ITIL service operations processes and methodologies

Job Title: Product Management Transformation Specialist

Job Category: Project and Program Management

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity:
CACI seeks an experienced Product Management Transformation Specialist for a critical execution role supporting the United States Secret Service (USSS) contract within the Department of Homeland Security. This position enhances national security by driving hands-on execution and coordination of modern product management practices across the agency's OCIO product ecosystem.

You will support the agency's shift from traditional project management toward outcome-based, user-centered, iterative product delivery. Working with product owners, technical teams, and mission stakeholders, you'll execute product discovery, manage backlogs, coordinate delivery activities, and maintain visibility into product performance.

This role combines hands-on product management execution (user research, product artifacts, roadmaps, agile ceremonies) with coordination activities (coaching teams, supporting governance, tracking metrics, enabling continuous improvement) aligned with the 21st Century IDEA Act, OMB agile guidance, and agency IT modernization strategies.

Note: Primarily remote with possible regular onsite presence in Washington, D.C. Candidates within driving distance of D.C. encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities:
Product Management Execution & Delivery Support-
Support product discovery, user research, requirements development, backlog management, prioritization, and performance measurement
Develop and maintain product artifacts (user stories, requirements, KPIs, roadmaps, vision statements, acceptance criteria) ensuring measurable improvements to mission outcomes
Partner with UX/design, engineering, data, and cybersecurity leads to balance user value, technical feasibility, and compliance/security constraints
Manage product backlogs, coordinate agile planning cycles, sprint reviews, and retrospectives; facilitate collaboration across engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and mission teams

Coordination, Governance & Program Management -
Coordinate product management initiatives, schedules, dependencies, risks, milestones, and deliverables ensuring disciplined execution
Support product governance, stakeholder engagement, and reporting while maintaining visibility into performance and delivery progress
Monitor delivery team health, velocity, and outcomes; identify issues and escalate risks as needed
Serve as liaison between technical teams, business owners, acquisition staff, and product leadership
Coordinate with Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and Product Owner to clarify roles and avoid duplication

Metrics, Reporting & Performance Tracking-
Support definition and tracking of product success metrics (OKRs, KPIs, customer experience measures); establish dashboards and reporting mechanisms
Produce status reports, executive briefings, and transformation scorecards for agency leadership and oversight bodies
Maintain visibility into product performance, user adoption, satisfaction metrics, and delivery progress
Manage risks and issues; maintain and update Risk & Issue Register

Capability Building, Coaching & Training Support-
Coach government product owners, program managers, and IT staff in product management fundamentals, agile delivery, and user-centered design
Support design and delivery of training, workshops, and coaching programs
Contribute to communities of practice, playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures
Mentor government staff, building internal capability to sustain the product management operating model

Change Management & Continuous Improvement -
Facilitate retrospectives and continuous improvement cycles; support post-launch reviews and lessons learned
Support execution of transformation change management plan including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption activities
Maintain Stakeholder Engagement Plans ensuring alignment with CIO leadership, division chiefs, mission operators, acquisition staff, and technical teams
Identify organizational, cultural, and procedural barriers; recommend mitigation strategies
Support adaptation of planning, funding, procurement, and oversight processes (PPBE, IT investment review, Agile/DevSecOps SDLC) to enable iterative delivery

Ensure alignment with federal frameworks: 21st Century IDEA Act, Section 508, NIST/RMF security, and enterprise architecture standards

Product Governance & Operating Model Support -
Support establishment and maturation of product management practices, governance structures, lifecycle stages, and decision frameworks
Contribute to maturity assessment and design of target-state product management operating model
Support development of Product Management Framework & Playbook, Portfolio & Roadmap, Templates, Backlog & Prioritization Models, and User Research Documentation

Required:

- Bachelor's degree + 10 years in product management, digital services delivery, or technology consulting (equivalencies: 16 years no degree, AA + 12 years, MA + 7 years)

- Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance
- Experience supporting organizational/digital transformation in federal, state, or large public-sector agencies
- Track record working with/coaching cross-functional agile product teams
- Deep knowledge of product management: vision/strategy, discovery, roadmapping, backlog management, outcome-based metrics
- Strong understanding of agile/lean frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and DevSecOps practices

Desired:

Job Title: Systems Engineer/Product Owner

Job Category: Engineering

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Top Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

Job Description:
CACI is looking for a self-motivated Systems Engineer/Product Owner to support the fast-paced counter-uncrewed aircraft systems (C-UxS) mission. We leverage open-architecture software and expertise in the electromagnetic spectrum to enable quick, informed decision-making. Join this passionate team of industry-leading individuals on a program that delivers state of the art capability to the DoD. Learn more about the innovative, technology-centric solutions CACI creates and delivers to support this mission: C-UxS | CACI .

What You’ll get to Do: You will be responsible for working with stakeholders to develop requirements and working with interdisciplinary groups to deliver and field cutting-edge tactical signals intelligence (SIGINT) and electronic warfare (EW) systems to the DoD.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Responsible for the decomposition of top-level system customer needs to lower-level technical requirements and work closely with development teams to build, integrate, and test the system.
- Lead, manage and groom backlogs at the portfolio level.
- Maintain and groom roadmaps for various development teams to ensure a clear understanding of requirements, participate in release/sprint planning, integration and testing.
- Responsible for the technical accuracy on software projects for specific customer programs, tracking delivery schedules, CDRL delivery, and performing factory acceptance testing of new hardware and software.
- Pushing the software baseline forward by continuing process improvement and using agile software development process.
- Validate that the delivered product meets the defined acceptance criteria and fulfills customer needs, while improving speed of mission delivery aligned with DevSecOps automation.

You’ll Bring These Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering Science, Engineering Management, or related discipline from an accredited college or university
- 5+ years of related experience is required. Five (5) years of additional SE experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.
- Current TS clearance and able to obtain SCI
- Must have experience with all stages of the Systems Engineering Lifecycle (SELC): Concept of Operations (CONOPS), requirements development, design, verification and validation testing, quality assurance, system integration, and operations support; including the development of requirements directly with stakeholders, as well as the development and execution of test plans/procedures.
- Experience designing, analyzing, testing, and verifying information and operational support systems for DoD customer from inception to support and operations and the ability to present technical information to numerous stakeholders.
- Experience with Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and working with a team of software personnel
- Excellent written and verbal skills to generate CDRLs for customer delivery.
- Experience with managing and documenting system configurations.
- Experience with agile development programs and supporting applications (e.g., JIRA, Mingle).

These Qualifications Would Be Nice to Have:
- Experience with RF software and hardware systems.
- Experience with Digital Signal Processing (DSP) software and hardware.
- Experience developing UML/SysML models with MBSE tools such as a Cameo Systems Modeler
- Experience with test automation

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity:
CACI’s Radar and Sensor Technologies group is seeking a talented Product Owner to lead our DevSecOps and SysAdmin team supporting one of our primary programs working with the US Government to build, maintain, and improve multiple complex environments. In this position, you will lead the Agile scrum team and be the foundation for our software programs ensuring systems function as expected to keep our nation safe. Our ideal candidate is a hard-charging platform engineer familiar with Agile processes that can learn quickly. You should have a strong understanding of IaC, containerization, automated test, and deployment pipelines to evolve our existing software infrastructure and architecture.

The position is onsite in Ypsilanti, Michigan, or Chantilly, VA.

This work requires candidates to be a US citizen holding a TS/SCI Poly.

Responsibilities:
- Oversee an Agile scrum team of 5-10 contributors.
- Build a vision for our platform currently and in the future, including identifying opportunities for resiliency and platform flexibility.
- Drive the Agile cadence including writing Feature acceptance criteria and descriptions, monitor progress, and troubleshoot as needed.
- Present to customer efficiently and at the appropriate technical level.
- Contribute to the design and implementation of comprehensive CICD pipelines with seamless automation and reduced build times.
- Deploy/troubleshoot in Cloud environments (prefer AWS) and instances.
- Effective at cross-organizational communication with the ability to work well in a small team.
- Mentor junior developers and foster their professional growth; design organizational and programmatic best practices for CI/CD and automated testing.
- Work within a team environment to advance large software development packages by taking on and completing tasks independently.

Qualifications:
Required:
- US citizenship with an active TS/SCI Poly.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technology fields or 5 years of professional experience.
- IAT Level II or III certification (i.e. Security+, CISSP, or CASP).
- Expertise in Kubernetes, Ansible, and/or Helm.
- Experience navigating Linux systems.
- Experience deploying in AWS environment.
- Familiarity with government requirements for DevSecOps and regulations for code deployments.
- Familiarity with Agile Scrum.
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Desired:
- Experience with software programs in operations.
- Demonstrated excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with virtual teams.
- Professional experience in radar or electro-optical fields.
- Experience in the operational deployment of multi-product baselines and functionality.

- Desire to learn new technologies.
